original_text: আমাদের গ্রামে কোনো হাসপাতাল নেই। জরুরি সময়ে প্রায় ৩০ কিলোমিটার যেতে হয়।
translated_text: There is no hospital in our village. In emergency situations we have to travel nearly 30 km.
issue_summary: Absence of nearby hospital in rural block causing 30km emergency travel.
recommended_intervention: Establish a 24/7 Primary Health Centre with ambulance transport facilities.
reasoning: High travel distance for urgent health needs poses life risks to rural citizens.

original_text: ನಮ್ಮ ಗ್ರಾಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆ ಇಲ್ಲ. ತುರ್ತು ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ 30 ಕಿಲೋಮೀಟರ್ ದೂರ ಹೋಗಬೇಕು.
translated_text: There is no hospital in our village. In emergencies we have to travel 30 kilometers away.
issue_summary: No nearby hospital in the village, forcing residents to travel 30km during emergencies.
recommended_intervention: Deploy mobile medical units and construct a primary health clinic serving rural Mysuru clusters.
reasoning: High urgency and significant travel distance reported in local language.

original_text: हमारे गांव में अच्छी सड़क नहीं है और बारिश के समय सड़क पूरी तरह खराब हो जाती है। एम्बुलेंस भी नहीं आ पाती।
translated_text: Our village does not have a good road and during rain the road gets completely damaged. Even ambulances cannot come.
issue_summary: Unpaved road blocks emergency ambulance access during monsoon season.
recommended_intervention: Upgrade rural village road under PMGSY all-weather road scheme.
reasoning: Lack of all-weather road isolates village during rains and blocks essential emergency vehicles.

original_text: எங்கள் கிராமத்தில் ஆரம்ப சுகாதார நிலையம் இல்லை. அவசர தேவைக்கு 25 கி.மீ செல்ல வேண்டும்.
translated_text: Our village has no primary health center. For emergencies we have to travel 25 km.
issue_summary: Absence of Primary Health Center forcing 25km emergency travel.
recommended_intervention: Construct 24/7 Primary Health Centre in rural block under State Health Mission.
reasoning: Distance to emergency medical care increases preventable mortality risks.

original_text: మా ఊరిలో మంచి ఆసుపత్రి లేదు. అత్యవసర సమయంలో 35 కిలోమీటర్లు ప్రయాణించాలి.
translated_text: There is no good hospital in our village. In emergency times we have to travel 35 kilometers.
issue_summary: Lack of accessible hospital forcing 35km travel during critical illness.
recommended_intervention: Establish Community Health Center with emergency trauma unit.
reasoning: High travel distance for urgent health needs poses grave risks.

original_text: Our village in Mysuru district does not have a nearby hospital. During medical emergencies we have to travel 30 km to reach the city center.
translated_text: Our village in Mysuru district does not have a nearby hospital. During medical emergencies we have to travel 30 km to reach the city center.
issue_summary: Lack of primary healthcare center causing 30km travel during critical medical emergencies.
recommended_intervention: Establish a 24/7 Primary Health Centre (PHC) with emergency transport facilities in rural Mysuru.
reasoning: High travel distance for urgent health needs poses life risks to rural citizens.

original_text: আমাদের প্রাথমিক বিদ্যালয়ে সুপেয় পানীয় জলের জন্য নলকূপ খারাপ হয়ে রয়েছে।
translated_text: The tube-well for drinking water in our primary school is out of order.
issue_summary: Broken tube-well leaving primary school students without safe drinking water.
recommended_intervention: Repair school tube-well and install solar-powered RO water filter.
reasoning: Drinking water failure in schools directly affects student health.

original_text: ನಮ್ಮ ಶಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಶೌಚಾಲಯ ಮತ್ತು ಶುದ್ಧ ಕುಡಿಯುವ ನೀರಿನ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ.
translated_text: Our school lacks proper toilet facilities and clean drinking water supply.
issue_summary: Government primary school lacks functional toilets and drinking water.
recommended_intervention: Construct separate functional toilets for boys/girls and install safe drinking water filtration systems in rural schools.
reasoning: Basic sanitation in schools directly impacts student attendance and health.

original_text: हमारे प्राथमिक विद्यालय में 120 बच्चों के लिए केवल 1 शिक्षक है और इमारत की छत से पानी टपकता है।
translated_text: In our primary school there is only 1 teacher for 120 children and water leaks from the building roof.
issue_summary: Severe teacher deficit (1 teacher for 120 students) and leaking school roof.
recommended_intervention: Sanction immediate building repairs under Samagra Shiksha and recruit primary teachers.
reasoning: Critical teacher shortage impairs fundamental literacy and basic education quality.

original_text: எங்கள் பகுதியில் குடிநீர் 5 நாட்களுக்கு ஒருமுறை மட்டுமே விநியோகிக்கப்படுகிறது.
translated_text: In our locality drinking water is supplied only once every 5 days.
issue_summary: Severe water shortage with tap water supplied only once every 5 days.
recommended_intervention: Commission Jal Jeevan Mission bulk water pipeline and overhead tank.
reasoning: Drinking water scarcity severely affects community health and sanitation.

original_text: మా గ్రామానికి ప్రభుత్వ బస్సు సదుపాయం లేదు. విద్యార్థులు 8 కిలోమీటర్లు నడవాల్సి వస్తోంది.
translated_text: There is no government bus facility for our village. Students have to walk 8 kilometers.
issue_summary: Absence of public bus service forcing students to walk 8km daily.
recommended_intervention: Introduce morning and evening rural feeder mini-bus service.
reasoning: Lack of transport restricts education and employment access.

original_text: Severe drinking water scarcity in our locality. Water supply comes only once every 4 days for 1 hour.
translated_text: Severe drinking water scarcity in our locality. Water supply comes only once every 4 days for 1 hour.
issue_summary: Critical water shortage with tap water available only once every 4 days.
recommended_intervention: Accelerate Jal Jeevan Mission tap connection coverage and bulk water supply pipelines.
reasoning: Basic drinking water availability is severely compromised in drought-prone Latur.
